snippet.title: Sony PSP : King's Field - Additional II (JPN)
snippet.description:
King's Field - Additional II (キングスフィールド アディショナルII) is a first person, dungeon-based RPG that developed and published by the FROM Software studio (2006), exclusively for the Japanese market and the PSP handheld system.

As you can see, the game has an excellent artwrok, interesting-atmospheric soundtrack but on the other hand, it's quite different from the main series as the gameplay is quite slow & there's no actual animation.
